newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil rejects extradition of wanted Italian man.
newsitem.headline: Brazil rejects extradition of wanted Italian man.

text.p: Brazilian authorities rejected on Thursday Italy's extradition request for an Italian man wanted in Italy for ties to the leftist Red Brigade guerrilla group of the 1970s, Globo television news reported.
TV Globo said Brazil's Supreme Federal Tribunal had rejected the extradition request because 47-year-old Luciano Pessina was wanted for politically motivated crimes.
Pessina, a political scientist who owns two Rio de Janeiro restaurants, was arrested in Brazil in August following the extradition request.
He was sentenced in Italy to eight years and 11 months in prison for robbery and illegal weapons and explosives possession.
